title: Pan
description: A pan shot rotates the camera horizontally around a fixed position, yaw on the vertical axis, feet planted. The support does not travel; the horizon should stay level as the frame sweeps the world.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Connect two facts without moving the feet. A look, a landscape, a second person: the pan can reveal, follow, anticipate, or delay.
Small pans also reframe blocking so the camera stays almost invisible while power changes inside the frame. Unmotivated constant drifting weakens that change.
If nothing new is being connected, the pan is fidget. A truck or a dolly is the tool when you need parallax, not a swing.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Tripod or a locked remote head. Rotate on the vertical axis; keep the bubble level unless you mean a Dutch.
Speed is a choice: crawl, follow, or whip. Near objects smear at the edges on a fast pan; they do not shear as they would on a dolly.
Prompt: Pan across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis from a fixed point, a horizontal sweep of the world.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to join two facts from one stance: a gun and a face, a window and a street, a speaker and a listener. Do not pan as a substitute for laying track.

blocks.text: Pan Left and Pan Right name direction. A Whip Pan is the same axis at a speed that blurs the join.
A Tilt pitches on the other axis. A Dolly moves the body, so parallax appears.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Searchers and There Will Be Blood sweep land from a planted stance. Eyes Wide Shut adjusts framing as dance partners move.
12 Angry Men reframes as the jury's alliances shift. Rear Window surveys a courtyard.
The Stendhal Syndrome uses a museum pan as a survey.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Plant the feet. Still: Pan across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis from a fixed point, a horizontal sweep of the world.
Video: The camera pans across [Subject] from a tripod, horizon level, no body travel. Name start and end facts.
Forbid a dolly.

Two siblings argue quietly at a kitchen table. Hold a two-shot; when one stands, gently tilt and pan to include her without cutting. As she leans back toward the seated brother, settle into a tighter shared composition. No arbitrary camera movement.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a trucking shot. The tell: foreground shearing as if the camera walked.
The fix: lock the position, yaw only, keep the horizon level, and let the join be angular, not spatial.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Pan in film?
A pan rotates the camera horizontally from a fixed position. The feet stay put; the frame sweeps left or right to connect two facts.
Pan vs Dolly
A pan yaws on sticks, so distances do not change by travel. A dolly moves the camera through space and produces parallax.
When should I use Pan?
Use it to connect two facts without walking, or to reframe blocking. Do not use it as fake geography.
How do I prompt Pan for AI image or video?
Write a tripod, a level horizon, and no body travel. Example: Pan across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis from a fixed point, a horizontal sweep of the world.
